entry.title: dotnet/efcore - Issues & Pull Requests - 2026-09-11
entry.content:
Issues

Created

  • GroupBy aggregate over a required navigation with a query filter drops entire groups (Regression in 11.0) #38965
    11.0.0
  • Precompiled queries: no extensibility point for provider-defined query terminal methods (blocks NativeAOT for third-party providers) #38962
    12.0.0
  • EF10 Upgrade cause Regression in query times due to linq-translations #38961
    12.0.0
  • SQLite migration lock `__EFMigrationsLock` table row not cleared when migration throws or is cancelled at certain times #38958
    12.0.0

Closed

  • Cosmos: Translate Enum.HasFlag #35317
    12.0.0
  • Entity Splitting: allow optional split table #27974
    Backlog
  • Query Translation: difference between x.Count()==0 and !x.Any() #27953
    12.0.0
  • SQLite: unhandled ObjectDisposedException can terminate process during connection pool pruning #38854
    12.0.0

PullRequests

Created

  • Release migration lock when Migrate/MigrateAsync fails before MigrateImplementation #38972
  • SQLite: do not report success when a later statement or a busy commit fails #38971
    community-contribution
  • [release/11.0]: Bump Microsoft.DotNet.XUnitV3Extensions from 11.0.0-beta.26454.1 to 11.0.0-beta.26461.3 #38970
    area-infrastructure
  • [release/11.0]: Bump Microsoft.Data.SqlClient.Extensions.Azure from 7.0.2 to 7.0.3 #38969
    area-infrastructure
  • [release/11.0]: Bump Microsoft.Data.SqlClient from 7.0.2 to 7.0.3 #38968
    area-infrastructure
  • [release/11.0]: Bump Microsoft.AspNetCore.Identity.EntityFrameworkCore from 9.0.19 to 9.0.20 #38966
    area-infrastructure
  • [automated] Merge branch 'release/11.0' => 'main' #38964
  • Stream GroupBy elements instead of joining the source back to itself #38963
    community-contribution
  • Parse scaffolded date and time default literals with the invariant culture #38959
    community-contribution

Merged

  • [release/11.0]: Bump Microsoft.Azure.Cosmos from 3.62.1 to 3.63.0 #38967
    area-infrastructure, 11.0-rc2
  • [release/11.0] Remove internal xUnit dependency from specification tests #38957
    tell-mode, 11.0-rc2
  • Add enum and comparison translators for Cosmos #35405
    community-contribution, 12.0.0
  • [release/10.0]: Bump Microsoft.AspNetCore.Identity.EntityFrameworkCore from 9.0.19 to 9.0.20 #38953
    area-infrastructure
  • Translate Any/All over a grouping element as an aggregate #38937
    community-contribution, 12.0.0
  • Bump Microsoft.Testing.Extensions.CodeCoverage from 18.10.0 to 18.11.0 #38934
    area-infrastructure, 12.0-preview1
  • [automated] Merge branch 'release/11.0' => 'main' #38950
    12.0-preview1
  • Optional entity splitting fragments #38749
    community-contribution, api-review, 12.0.0
  • Rewrite APPLY over json_each into a join on SQLite #38688
    community-contribution, 12.0.0
  • [automated] Merge branch 'release/9.0' => 'release/10.0' #38945
  • SQLite: do not clear the rollback hook through a handle that is closing #38880
    community-contribution, 12.0.0

Updated

  • [automated] Merge branch 'release/10.0' => 'release/11.0' #38956
  • [release/11.0] Fix UPDATE ordering regression for unique-index reassignment #38924
